mission: Build Prometeo into a durable self-compounding multi-root cognitive operating system where many disposable chats can behave as guide-grade cognitive workers, self-assign useful work, continue multi-stage tasks, discover new work, recover stalls, integrate locally by page/root, and minimize human coordination.
human_goal: The human can paste the same worker bootstrap into many fresh chats, potentially 50+, without numbering, routing, result transport or routine integration. Workers should think with the same strategic posture as the guide, while mutation authority stays scoped. Plan de acción/Universal Control, Prometeo móvil, Facultad Digital/Study Library and Alumnos/página docente should each become continuous page-level work surfaces with local planners/stewards and micro-swarms.
current_frontier: Two compounding tracks now run in parallel. Track A preserves GEN-PROMETEO-ACCEL-02: five executable closed-loop implementation opportunities plus recursive N+1/N+2 gates remain active. Track B is the new Universal Cognitive Swarm canary: /wc v3.0 + UNIVERSAL_COGNITIVE_WORKER_V1 + STALE_RECOVERY_PROTOCOL_V1 + MULTI_SURFACE_SWARM_EXECUTION_PLAN_V1 + Q-UNIVERSAL-COGNITIVE-SWARM-01. That queue contains 60 staged opportunities, 52 explicitly READY at publication, covering executable worker infrastructure, seven independent lenses on each of four surfaces, critics/metrics/archaeology, then four local integrations, cross-surface integration, ~50-worker stress verification, fresh strategic critic and production-readiness gate. Prepared architecture is not proof; the next evidence target is a real broad identical-worker wave that demonstrates distinct/complementary claims, multi-stage continuation, dynamic successor activation, local integration and safe recovery.
current_human_action: Launch many fresh `/wc` chats with the exact same bootstrap. This canary is intentionally provisioned for approximately 50 simultaneous fresh workers; no unique numbers or prompts are required. More than the remaining useful frontier may still become idle rather than invent filler.
verified_progress: Universal /g guide bootstrap remains durable; old parent chat identity is unnecessary.
GEN-PROMETEO-ACCEL-02 remains preserved as the executable recursive-Planner track.

Universal Cognitive Worker v1 is now a durable binding canary model: guide-grade cognition, scoped authority, role-fluid allocation, multi-checkpoint continuation, surplus discovery and local page integration.
Stale/Recovery Protocol v1 now defines durable heartbeat/checkpoint, 20-minute suspicion, 30-minute recovery eligibility, append-only recovery attempts, CAS safety and late-return reconciliation.
Multi-Surface Swarm Execution Plan v1 defines parallel discovery/foundation -> four local stewards -> cross-surface integration -> stress/critic -> production-readiness stages.
Q-UNIVERSAL-COGNITIVE-SWARM-01 publishes 60 opportunities, 52 explicitly READY at publication and 8 dependency-gated successors.
/wc v3.0 is published on main and gh-pages and loads the new universal worker kernel/plan/stale policy plus all active queues.
The broad launch target is a canary, not a production claim; /w remains gated.
must_preserve: Workers are cognitive peers for worker-solvable reasoning, not automatic peers in global mutation authority.
No capability is operational without durable exercise evidence.
Do not make the global guide the routine scheduler, local merger or stale detector.
Multiple workers may intentionally work on the same page under different roles/lenses; exact exclusive mutation remains claim-protected.
Sequential same-context work should stay with one worker when efficient; newly-unblocked successor work is atomically claimed so it cannot be duplicated.
Prepared queue exhaustion triggers deduplicated discovery/recovery before idle, but never filler work.
Returns remain immutable candidate evidence; local/global integration and promotion remain separate.
Human Accepted, Current and Served remain distinct authorities.
Late returns from recovered/superseded attempts remain evidence and must be reconciled.
Historical Prometeo mechanisms should be reused/reconciled before inventing duplicates.
negative_knowledge: Do not reduce the user's request to Live telemetry or a finite READY queue.
Do not insist the human open exactly N workers merely because a parent-prepared queue currently has N tasks; broad capacity may perform complementary page work and deduplicated discovery.
Do not call 50-worker parallelism useful merely because 50 chats are busy; measure durable useful output, collision/idle rates and human-intervention reduction.
Do not let local stewards silently fork global shared capabilities or self-promote authority.
Do not declare stale from silence before policy thresholds/evidence.
Do not deploy /w production or unattended event loop merely because v3.0 bootstrap/specs exist.
next_actions: Run the broad identical /wc wave and allow claims to spread across old GEN2 plus the 52 new READY universal-swarm lanes.
Consume returns incrementally rather than waiting for the whole wave.
As dependency sets complete, derive local page integration opportunities READY automatically and let any universal worker claim them.
Let workers re-enter allocation after RETURN and continue through sequential successors or useful discovery.
Detect/recover eligible stalled attempts using append-only recovery claims; preserve late original returns.
Run O-SWARM-50-WORKER-STRESS-VERIFY-V1 and O-SWARM-FRESH-STRATEGIC-CRITIC-V1 when their gates become satisfied.
Only after evidence, decide whether production /w can inherit the universal cognitive behavior.
continuation_rule: Fresh guide uses /g -> Continuity Head -> this FOCUS -> exact active queues/claims/runs/returns/recovery/proposals. Fresh worker uses the same /wc v3.0 bootstrap. Bare `.` integrates evidence, advances dependency-derived readiness, preserves both GEN2 and universal-swarm tracks, and persists the next frontier without forcing the human to locate or merge worker chats.
